purpose: Freeze how empirical mitochondrial sequence differentiation would be converted into the already-qualified genetic-TTF estimand if and only if the frozen genetic Gate-D returns PASS. This file does not authorize opening sequence characters, pairwise genetic distances, Monmonier outputs, or break labels.
authorization_precondition: A separate explicit empirical-opening authorization may be created only after a completed frozen Gate-D report has status PASS and empirical_pilot_opening_eligible=true.

source.panel: the same 221 species, one frozen species-locus panel per species, 5,583 localities, 20,987 density-scaled graph edges, and 111/110 train-evaluation split used by genetic Gate-D
forbidden_sources: any outcome-selected alternative locus or species panel

observation_contract.node: exact latitude-longitude locality already frozen by the response-blind geometry pipeline
observation_contract.multiple_sequences_same_locality: retain all frozen-locus sequences linked to the locality; do not create within-locality graph edges
observation_contract.sequence_normalization: uppercase aligned sequence characters; only A,C,G,T are canonical comparable states
observation_contract.sequence_pair_distance: uncorrected p-distance = canonical mismatches divided by columns where both sequences are canonical A/C/G/T
observation_contract.minimum_comparable_rule: A sequence pair is valid only when its number of comparable canonical columns is at least ceil(0.5 * frozen alignment length). Gaps, N, and IUPAC ambiguity codes are ignored rather than counted as matches or mismatches.
observation_contract.locality_pair_distance: arithmetic mean of all valid cross-locality sequence-pair p-distances for the two localities
observation_contract.edge_response: the locality-pair distance for each already-frozen graph edge
observation_contract.edge_missingness_rule: Do not delete, replace, or rewire an edge after sequence opening. If any frozen edge for a species has no valid cross-locality sequence pair, that species is empirical-outcome NOT_EVALUABLE under the frozen graph.
observation_contract.species_unit: species, never sequence or edge, remains the inferential unit

primary_estimand.trait_construction: endpoint-safe leave-two-localities-out rank-IBD residualization followed by within-species residual rank turnover, exactly as qualified by genetic Gate-D
primary_estimand.training_geometry_control: the frozen v0.11 training-only edge-length geometry control, unchanged
primary_estimand.transfer: the frozen 500-km transferable turnover field on the 111 training species scored on the 110 completely held-out species
primary_estimand.primary_statistic: mean held-out species Spearman transfer score T
primary_estimand.empirical_p_value: profiled-private upper Monte Carlo p-value using the completed Gate-D private-reference families; the two nuisance configurations are selected using training strength only, never empirical held-out T

primary_interpretation.positive_result: A small profiled-private p-value with positive held-out T is pilot evidence that geographic location predicts mitochondrial intraspecific differentiation in unseen species beyond the frozen IBD and sampling-geometry controls.
primary_interpretation.negative_result: A non-significant pilot result is inconclusive and must not be called lineage-specific unless a separately predeclared within-species detectability gate has also qualified.
primary_interpretation.claim_scope: mitochondrial phylogeographic differentiation on this published development panel, not genome-wide differentiation and not fresh confirmatory evidence

secondary_analyses.species_scores: report all held-out C_s values and their class membership after the primary result is fixed
secondary_analyses.spatial_field: map the training-derived field and support only after the primary inferential receipt is frozen
secondary_analyses.aves_to_chiroptera_and_chiroptera_to_ave: not inferentially authorized by this protocol; reciprocal class transfer requires a separate response-blind geometry census and its own synthetic qualification before empirical class-transfer scores are opened
secondary_analyses.common_marker_replications: COI/CYTB/ND2 or other marker-specific replications are secondary and require frozen eligibility rules before their outcomes are inspected

forbidden_after_empirical_opening: switching from mean locality-pair p-distance to median or minimum based on results
changing comparable-site rules based on transfer performance
dropping poorly fitting species or graph edges after seeing genetic distances
changing bandwidth, graph degree, species split, IBD residualization, private-null profiling, or alpha
using Decker Monmonier break outputs to tune or validate the primary TTF statistic
describing a non-significant result as evidence for lineage-specific history without a separately qualified detectability analysis
